William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

Selections from ‘Jerusalem’

[The Words of Los]

(
Jerusalem,
 f. 10, ll. 20–1.)
I 
MUST
 Create a System, or be enslav’d by another Man’s;
I will not Reason and Compare: my business is to Create.
